# Other Module

A QML module whose type names compete with TestModule's.


Its [OtherModule.Layout](qml-othermodule-layout.md) type has the same name as [TestModule](testmodule-qmlmodule.md)'s Layout type, but different members.


| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Button](qml-othermodule-button.md) | A QML type imported by name and by alias from TestModule. |
| [Layout](qml-othermodule-layout.md) | A QML type whose name competes with TestModule's Layout. |
